title: Repair Order Shop Fees — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
Repair-order-level shop fees under Service Accounts and Repair Orders are charged once per repair order for each kind of fee.

| Fee | How it is figured |
|---|---|
| Shop supplies | The tier's shop supplies share of the repair order's customer-pay labor amount after discount, rounded to the cent and capped at the tier's shop supplies cap. No shop supplies fee is charged on a repair order without customer-pay labor. |
| Hazardous waste | The tier's flat hazardous waste fee, charged once on a repair order with a customer-pay oil, fluid or filter service. |
| Tire disposal | The tier's disposal fee per tire times the number of scrap tires removed on a customer-pay tire replacement; the count of tires is recorded with the fee. |
| Storage | Charged when a finished vehicle is not collected within the tier's free storage days (calendar days after the completion notice); the tier's daily storage fee times each further calendar day up to the day of pickup, the chargeable days being recorded with the fee. |
| Mobile service | Offered within the tier's mobile service radius of the store; the tier's trip fee per visit. |

A fee whose amount works out to 0.00 is not posted.

**Storage, counted (hypothetical).** With 3 free days and a completion notice on 10 June, the free days run to 13 June. A vehicle picked up on 13 June owes no storage; one picked up on 16 June owes 3 chargeable days (14, 15 and 16 June) at the daily fee.

**Shop supplies (hypothetical).** At an 8% share and a 49.95 cap, customer-pay labor after discount of 380.00 gives 30.40; labor of 700.00 gives 56.00, held to 49.95.
